author: KEXP
description: Washington D.C. punk duo Teen Mortgage unleash relentless energy in their fuzz-heavy Live on KEXP in-studio session. With Sonic Reducer host West Keller, the band share a performance of "Burn" and more.
title: Teen Mortgage performs "Burn" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
